steps.en: Get the module into an NGINX build — in practice, install OpenResty instead
steps.zh: 把模块装进 NGINX 构建——实践中直接用 OpenResty 套件

steps.en: Bind Lua to a request phase in nginx.conf
steps.zh: 在 nginx.conf 里把 Lua 绑到某个请求阶段

steps.en: Runs your Lua inside the worker's LuaJIT VM at exactly that phase — no IPC, no extra process
steps.zh: 在该阶段、worker 内的 LuaJIT 虚拟机里执行你的代码

component.zh: 每 worker 一个 LuaJIT 虚拟机

steps.en: Talk to Redis, a DB, or an HTTP upstream from the handler
steps.zh: 在处理器里访问 Redis、数据库或 HTTP 上游

steps.en: Your Lua yields on the cosocket; the event loop serves other requests and resumes it when data arrives
steps.zh: Lua 在 cosocket 上挂起，事件循环先服务其它请求、数据到达后再恢复

value.en: Per-request logic at NGINX/LuaJIT speed inside the proxy itself — no C module, no extra hop
value.zh: 逐请求逻辑以 NGINX/LuaJIT 的速度跑在代理进程内部——不写 C 模块，也不加一跳
